rules.name: Paragons of Terror
rules.effect: At the start of the first battle round, after selecting one or more Dread abilities to be active for your army, you can select one additional Dread ability to be active for your army (this additional Dread ability cannot be randomly selected).

stratagems.name: Pterrorshades
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that is within 12" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound and one model in your unit regains up to 1 lost wound.
stratagems.summary: Roll 6D6: on each 4+, enemy unit takes 1 mortal wound; your unit regains 1 wound.

stratagems.name: Conquerors Without Mercy
stratagems.timing: Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS model from your army that made a Charge move this turn and has not been selected to fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by your model by 1. After your model has finished making its attacks this phase, if it destroyed one or more enemy units this phase, each enemy unit within 6" of your model must take a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.summary: +1 AP to melee weapons; if destroys unit(s), enemy units within 6" take Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Disdain for the Weak
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability, and the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against attacks made by Battle-shocked models.
stratagems.summary: Feel No Pain 6+; Feel No Pain 5+ vs Battle-shocked models.

stratagems.name: A Long Leash
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One ABHORRENT unit from your army and up to two friendly WAR DOG units.
stratagems.effect: Until the start of your next Command phase, those WAR DOG units are treated as being within range of any Aura abilities your ABHORRENT unit has.
stratagems.summary: WAR DOG units in range of ABHORRENT unit's Aura abilities until start of next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Imperious Advance
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
stratagems.cond: Up to two WAR DOG units from your army or one TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units makes a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, it can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, it can move within Engagement Range of such models but, unless it made a Charge move, cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed (the Super-heavy Walker ability does not apply while using this Stratagem).
stratagems.summary: Move through models/terrain; can enter Engagement Range but not end there (except Charge); auto-pass Desperate Escape.

stratagems.name: Storm of Darkness
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Stealth. Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
stratagems.summary: Unit gains Stealth; melee attacks against it have -1 to Hit.

enhancements.name: Malevolent Heraldry
enhancements.effect: Each time you roll dice to randomly select which Dread abilities are active for your army, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can re-roll one or both results rolled.

enhancements.name: Veil of Medrengard
enhancements.effect: The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks, and a 5+ invulnerable save against melee attacks.

enhancements.name: Tyrant's Shadow
enhancements.effect: At the end of your Command phase, select one objective marker the bearer is in range of and that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. In addition, until you lose control of that objective marker, it has the Deathly Terror ability as if it were a ^^**Chaos Knights^^** model from your army.

enhancements.name: Nightmare's Master
enhancements.effect: At the start of the Fight phase, each enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

rules.name: Wretched Thralls
rules.effect:
- You can include DAMNED units in your army (see Codex: Chaos Space Marines). The combined points cost of such units cannot exceed 500 points. 
- Friendly DAMNED units can re-roll **leadership rolls**.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Masters!
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS unit is destroyed by an enemy unit.
stratagems.cond: That enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: That enemy unit is marked until the end of the battle. Friendly DAMNED units’ attacks that target a marked unit have [LETHAL HITS].
stratagems.summary: Mark enemy unit; friendly DAMNED units' attacks vs marked units gain [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Dark Sacrifice
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One friendly DAMNED unit (excluding ACCURSED CULTISTS units) within 9" of a friendly CHAOS KNIGHTS model.
stratagems.effect: Select one CHAOS KNIGHTS model within 9" of your unit and roll D3+3: Your DAMNED unit suffers that number of mortal wounds. That CHAOS KNIGHTS model heals that number of wounds.
stratagems.summary: DAMNED unit suffers D3+3 MW; CHAOS KNIGHTS model within 9" heals that many.

stratagems.name: Coursing Thralls
stratagems.timing: Start of your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One friendly DAMNED unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit is hunted: While a unit is hunted, that unit has +6" detection range.
stratagems.summary: Mark visible enemy unit within 12" as hunted; hunted units have +6" detection range.

enhancements.name: Cruel Lashmaster
enhancements.effect: While a friendly DAMNED unit is within 6" of this model, when that unit is selected to make a normal/advance/fall-back move that unit has +2" M until the end of the phase.

enhancements.name: Iconoclast Idol
enhancements.effect: While a friendly DAMNED unit is within 6" of this model, when you target that unit with the Heroic Intervention stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

rules.name: Tyrannical Court
rules.effect: Improve the Objective Control characteristic of ^^**Chaos Knight Character^^** models from your army by 2. In addition, once per battle round, if your ^^**Warlord^^** is on the battlefield, you can use the Claimed for the Dark Gods Stratagem for 0CP.

stratagems.name: Claimed for the Dark Gods
stratagems.timing: Start of your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control, with a Level of Control of 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.summary: Secure objective marker at Level of Control 5 until opponent exceeds it.

stratagems.name: Spiteful Demise
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army is destroyed.
stratagems.cond: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: When rolling to determine whether mortal wounds are inflicted by your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, that model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of a 4+ instead of on a 6.
stratagems.summary: Deadly Demise triggers on 4+ instead of 6.

stratagems.name: Runes of Disdain
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
stratagems.summary: Subtract 1 from Damage of all incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Titanic Duel
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that enemy unit is TITANIC, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll instead.
stratagems.summary: Re-roll Hit/Wound rolls of 1 vs selected MONSTER/VEHICLE; re-roll all Hit/Wound rolls vs TITANIC units.

stratagems.name: Trophy Hunter
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just before a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army consolidates.
stratagems.cond: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit Consolidates, models in it can move an additional 3" as long as your unit can end that move within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.summary: Consolidate moves gain +3" if ending within Engagement Range of enemies.

stratagems.name: Crushed Like Vermin
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army ends a Normal move.
stratagems.cond: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) that your unit moved over during that move and roll six D6: for each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. If one or more models are destroyed as a result of this Stratagem, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
stratagems.summary: Roll 6D6 for each 4+: 1 mortal wound to enemy unit moved over; if models destroyed, Battle-shock test.

stratagems.name: Claimed for the Dark Gods
stratagems.timing: Start of your Command phase.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army that is within range of one or more objective markers you control.
stratagems.effect: Select one of those objective markers. That objective marker remains under your control, with a Level of Control of 5 (unless it would otherwise be higher), until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.summary: Secure objective marker at Level of Control 5 until opponent exceeds it.

enhancements.name: Warp-borne Stalker
enhancements.effect: The bearer has the Deep Strike ability. In addition, once per battle, at the end of your opponent's turn, if the bearer is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove it from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Blade of Celerity
enhancements.effect: The bearer's ranged weapons have the [Assault] ability. In addition, once per battle, in the Fight phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability.

enhancements.name: Putrid Carapace
enhancements.effect: The bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+. In addition, once per battle, at the start of either player's Command phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer regains up to D6 lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Mirror of Fates
enhancements.effect: Once per turn, when your opponent targets a unit from their army within 12” of this model with a **stratagem**, you can use this ability. If you do, increase the CP cost of that use of that **stratagem** by 1CP.

enhancements.name: Blessing of the Dark Master
enhancements.effect: The bearer has the Stealth ability. In addition, once per battle, after you make a saving throw for the bearer, you can change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: Throne Mechanicum of Skulls
enhancements.effect: You can re-roll Charge rolls made for the bearer's unit. In addition, once per battle, in your Charge phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer's unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

rules.name: Marked Prey
rules.effect:
At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent's army. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a ^^**War Dog^^** model from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, if that unit is visible to the attacking model, that attack has the [Sustained Hits 1] ability.


**Keywords**
While using the Houndpack Lance Detachment, the following rules apply:


- Your army must include 3 or more ^^**War Dog^^** units.
- ^^**War Dog^^** units from your army have the ^^**Battleline^^** keyword.
- When mustering your army, select 3 ^^**War Dog^^** units from your army. Until the end of the battle, those units have the ^^**Character^^** keyword.*


*** Designer's Note:** *This means that the selected units can be given Enhancements and one of them can be selected as your* ^^**Warlord^^**.

stratagems.name: Vox-howl
stratagems.timing: Start of the Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One WAR DOG CHARACTER unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Each enemy unit within 6" of your unit must take a Battle-shock test. Each friendly WAR DOG unit that is within 6" of your unit and is Battle-shocked must take a Leadership test; if that test is passed, that unit is no longer Battle-shocked.
stratagems.summary: Enemy units within 6" take Battle-shock test; friendly WAR DOG units within 6" remove Battle-shocked on passed Leadership test.

stratagems.name: Hungry for Combat
stratagems.timing: Start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: Two or more WAR DOG units from your army within Engagement Range of the same enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of those WAR DOG units. Until the end of the phase, models in those WAR DOG units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of those WAR DOG units makes an attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
stratagems.summary: WAR DOGs lock onto one enemy unit in Engagement Range; gain [LETHAL HITS] on attacks but can only target that unit.

stratagems.name: Cunning Hunter
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a WAR DOG unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.cond: That WAR DOG unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: Fell Back unit can shoot and declare charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Animalistic Rage
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after a WAR DOG unit from your army that has not been selected to attack this phase is destroyed.
stratagems.cond: That WAR DOG unit. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
stratagems.effect: Before resolving your unit’s Deadly Demise ability, it can either shoot or fight. When doing so, it must target only the enemy unit that just destroyed it, and can only do so if that enemy unit is an eligible target. After it has done so and after any Consolidation moves have been made, resolve your unit’s Deadly Demise ability as normal.
stratagems.summary: Shoot or fight before Deadly Demise, targeting only the unit that destroyed it; then resolve Deadly Demise normally.

stratagems.name: Harrying Hounds
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
stratagems.cond: One WAR DOG unit from your army that is within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 6".
stratagems.summary: Unit makes Normal move up to 6".

stratagems.name: Encircling Pack
stratagems.timing: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One WAR DOG unit from your army that is wholly within 12" of one or more battlefield edges and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.
stratagems.effect: Remove your unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves.
stratagems.summary: Remove unit from battlefield; place into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Loping Predator
enhancements.effect: The bearer's ranged weapons have the [Assault] ability.

enhancements.name: Final Howl (Aura)
enhancements.effect: While a friendly ^^**War Dog^^** model is within 6" of the bearer, each time that model makes an attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Panoply of the Cursed Knights
enhancements.effect: Each time an attack targets the bearer, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

enhancements.name: Preyslayer's Mantle
enhancements.effect: The bearer has the Super-Heavy Walker ability.

rules.name: Malefic Surge
rules.effect:
In your Command phase, one or more ^^**Chaos Knights^^** units from your army can make a Malefic Surge. Each one that does must first take a Leadership test; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is Empowered. While a unit is Empowered, it can use one of the Malefic Surge abilities below. Once that unit has used a Malefic Surge ability, it is no longer Empowered.

**Unholy Hunger:** When a model in this unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, until the end of the phase, add 3" to its Move characteristic.

**Diabolic Power:** When this unit is selected to shoot or fight, select either the [Lethal Hits] or [Sustained Hits 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in this unit have the selected ability.

**Unnatural Fortitude:** When this unit is selected as the target of an attack, until the end of the phase, select one of the following:
- Models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save
- Models in this unit have the Feel No Pain 6+ ability.

stratagems.name: Profane Symbiosis
stratagems.timing: End of any phase.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that is not Empowered.
stratagems.effect: Your unit makes a Malefic Surge.
stratagems.summary: Unit makes a Malefic Surge.

stratagems.name: Hellforged Construction
stratagems.timing: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.summary: -1 AP on incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Corrupting Taint
stratagems.timing: Your Command phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit from your army makes a Malefic Surge.
stratagems.cond: That CHAOS KNIGHTS CHARACTER unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective marker your unit is within range of that you control. That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.
stratagems.summary: Friendly-controlled objective marker remains yours until opponent's Level of Control exceeds yours.

stratagems.name: Unleash Balefire
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: After your unit has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test; if the test is failed, until the end of your opponent’s next turn, it is aflame. While a unit is aflame, subtract 2" from its Move characteristic and subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for it.
stratagems.summary: After shooting, select hit enemy unit; failed Battle-shock test makes it aflame until end of opponent's next turn (-2" Move, -2 Charge rolls).

stratagems.name: Warp Vision
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.
stratagems.summary: Grant [IGNORES COVER] to unit's ranged weapons.

stratagems.name: Diabolic Bulwark
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.
stratagems.summary: Grant 4+ invulnerable save to unit.

enhancements.name: Fleshmetal Fusion
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the bearer's Toughness characteristic. While the bearer is using the Unnatural Fortitude ability, each time an attack with a Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to the bearer, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.

enhancements.name: Blasphemous Engine
enhancements.effect: Add 2 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic. Each time the bearer's unit makes a Malefic Surge, you can re-roll the Leadership test taken to see if it suffers any mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Bestial Aspect
enhancements.effect: The bearer's ranged weapons have the [Assault] ability. While the bearer is using the Unholy Hunger ability, it can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and/or to Advance rolls made for its unit.

enhancements.name: Knight Diabolus
enhancements.effect: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons by 1. While the bearer is using the Diabolic Power ability, its melee weapons have the [Lance] ability.

rules.name: Masters of the Pack
rules.effect: If a ^^**Titanic Chaos Knights^^** unit from your army has an Aura ability that affects friendly ^^**War Dog^^** units, while two or more friendly ^^**War Dog^^** models are within range of that ^^**Titanic Chaos Knights^^** unit’s Aura ability, that ^^**Titanic Chaos Knights^^** unit is affected by that Aura ability as well.

stratagems.name: Feral Arrogance
stratagems.timing: Any phase, just after a mortal wound is allocated to a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army.
stratagems.cond: That CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against mortal wounds.
stratagems.summary: Feel No Pain 5+ vs mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Merciless Fusillade
stratagems.timing: Start of your Shooting phase or the start of the Fight phase.
stratagems.cond: One TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army, and up to two friendly WAR DOG units, that have not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit that is an eligible target for each of those CHAOS KNIGHTS units. Until the end of the phase, each time one of those Chaos Knights units is selected to shoot or fight, if that enemy unit is an eligible target, you can only select that enemy unit as the target for all of those attacks and those attacks have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
stratagems.summary: Lock selected enemy unit as only target; grant [SUSTAINED HITS 1] to Chaos Knights' attacks.

stratagems.name: Beasthide Manifestation
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
stratagems.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
stratagems.summary: -1 AP on incoming attacks.

stratagems.name: Flush the Quarry
stratagems.timing: Start of your Movement phase.
stratagems.cond: One TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army and up to three friendly WAR DOG units within 6" of that Titanic Chaos Knights unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time one of those War Dog units makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, its models can move through models and terrain features. When doing so, they can move within Engagement Range of such models but cannot end that move within Engagement Range of them, and any Desperate Escape test is automatically passed.
stratagems.summary: War Dogs ignore models/terrain when moving; can enter but not end in Engagement Range; auto-pass Desperate Escape tests.

stratagems.name: Contemptuous Volleys
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, just after a CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army Falls Back.
stratagems.cond: That CHAOS KNIGHTS unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
stratagems.summary: Fell Back unit can shoot and declare charge this turn.

stratagems.name: Goaded Beast
stratagems.timing: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.cond: One CHAOS KNIGHTS unit from your army that lost one or more wounds as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6"
stratagems.summary: Unit makes surge move of up to D6".

enhancements.name: Hunter's Helm
enhancements.effect: You can re‑roll Advance and Charge rolls made for the bearer’s unit.

enhancements.name: Octagram of Conjuration
enhancements.effect: While a friendly ^^**War Dog**^^ model is within 9” of this model, after that ^^**War Dog**^^ model has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. That enemy unit must take a Battle‑shock test.

enhancements.name: Throne Tyrannicus
enhancements.effect: In your Command phase, select one other ^^**Chaos Knights Character**^^ model within 9” of the bearer. If the bearer has one or more Aura abilities that affect friendly **^^War Dog**^^ units, until the start of your next Command phase, the selected **^^Chaos Knights Character**^^ model is affected by those Aura abilities as well.

enhancements.name: Aspect of the Beast
enhancements.effect: At the start of your Command phase, select one Dread ability to be active for the bearer until the start of your next Command phase, in addition to the Dread abilities active for your army.

rules.name: Annihilate the Unworthy
rules.effect: Friendly **KNIGHT TYRANT** units’ attacks that target a **battle-shocked** unit have +1 to the **hit roll**.

stratagems.name: Rune-cursed Stronghold
stratagems.timing: Any phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit suffers a mortal wound.
stratagems.cond: That KNIGHT TYRANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
stratagems.summary: Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

stratagems.name: Pitiless Focus
stratagems.timing: Your Movement phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit is selected to make a fall-back move.
stratagems.cond: That KNIGHT TYRANT unit.
stratagems.effect: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
stratagems.summary: Move and shoot in same turn.

stratagems.name: Intimidating Reminder
stratagems.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly KNIGHT TYRANT unit has shot.
stratagems.cond: That KNIGHT TYRANT unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next Command phase: While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.
stratagems.summary: Select hit enemy unit; suppress until start of your next Command phase (-1 to hit rolls).

enhancements.name: Pterrorshade Rookery
enhancements.effect: When this unit is **selected to shoot**, select one enemy unit within 24" of this unit. That enemy unit has +6" **detection range** until this unit has shot.

enhancements.name: Hate-filled Dominion
enhancements.effect: This unit can re-roll rolls to determine the **A** of a weapon.

rules.name: Scenting Fear
rules.effect:
(Once per battle round, per army) In your Shooting phase, you can select one **visible** enemy unit within 12" of a friendly **WAR DOG** unit. That enemy unit has +6" **detection range**.
This detachment has the WAR DOGS tag and cannot be taken with another WAR DOGS detachment.

abilities.effect:

Each time a model in this unit is **destroyed**, after the units embarked within it (if any) have made their **emergency disembark moves**, roll one D6. This ability always takes the form **Scouts X"**. In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step, if every model in a unit has this ability, you can do one of the following: 
- If that unit is in **strategic reserves**, you can set up that unit anywhere that is wholly within your deployment zone. 
- If that unit is wholly within your deployment zone, it can make a **scout move**. 
- If that unit is embarked within a **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** that is wholly within your deployment zone, and if every model embarked within that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** has the Scouts ability, that **DEDICATED TRANSPORT** can make a **scout move**.
